title: Insights into the recruitment of the H3K4me3 reader Spp1 by the meiotic double-strand break protein Mer2
authors: Liloku P; Melo DA; Gisbert VG; Mannaert S; Mechleb K; Derclaye S; Ray A; Alsteens D; Volkov AN; Sterckx YG; Bouuaert CC
one_liner_zh: 该文用AlphaFold建模和生化重构研究减数分裂DSB蛋白Mer2与H3K4me3阅读器Spp1的互作及DNA结合复合物组装，属广义蛋白-DNA互作且方法可迁移，但非典型TF-DNA体系。
abstract: The formation of DNA double-strand breaks (DSBs) by Spo11 is tied to the loop-axis organization of meiotic chromosomes. Prior to DSB formation, chromatin loops marked by histone H3K4 trimethylation become tethered to the chromosome axis through interactions between Spp1 and Mer2. Mer2 is an essential partner of Spo11 thought to assemble the DSB machinery via biomolecular condensation, but these molecular assemblies remain poorly characterized. Here, using AlphaFold modeling, biochemical reconstitution, and biophysical validation, we explored the relationship between Mer2, Spp1 and their DNA-bound complexes. The tetrameric coiled-coil domain of Mer2 has four rotationally symmetrical sites that can bind a C-terminal α-helix of Spp1. However, binding of one Spp1 subunit appears to allosterically modulate the affinity for the adjacent sites, leading to the assembly of 4×2 Mer2-Spp1 complexes. Mer2 also accommodates multiple DNA duplexes, allowing the assembly of tripartite Mer2-Spp1-DNA complexes with branched DNA substrates and effective recruitment of Spp1 within nucleoprotein condensates. However, because the Spp1- and DNA-binding sites of Mer2 partially overlap, Spp1 recruitment reduces DNA binding by Mer2, which is compensated for by a patch of positively charged residues within Spp1. These findings provide insights into the structural organization of Mer2 and Spp1 and their role in the assembly of the meiotic DSB machinery.
abstract_zh: Spo11 引发的 DNA 双链断裂（DSBs）形成与减数分裂染色体的环-轴组织密切相关。在 DSB 形成之前，以组蛋白 H3K4 三甲基化为标志的染色质环通过 Spp1 与 Mer2 之间的相互作用锚定至染色体轴。Mer2 是 Spo11 的关键伙伴，被认为通过生物分子凝聚 (biomolecular condensation) 组装 DSB 机制，但这些分子组装体的特征尚不清楚。本研究利用 AlphaFold 建模、生化重构和生物物理验证，探讨了 Mer2、Spp1 及其与 DNA 结合复合物之间的关系。Mer2 的四聚卷曲螺旋结构域具有四个旋转对称位点，可结合 Spp1 的 C 端 α-螺旋。然而，一个 Spp1 亚基的结合似乎通过变构调节邻近位点的亲和力，导致 4×2 Mer2-Spp1 复合物的组装。Mer2 还能容纳多个 DNA 双链体，从而允许三部分 Mer2-Spp1-DNA 复合物与分支 DNA 底物组装，并在核蛋白凝聚体中有效招募 Spp1。然而，由于 Mer2 的 Spp1 和 DNA 结合位点部分重叠，Spp1 招募会减少 Mer2 的 DNA 结合，这由 Spp1 内一个带正电荷残基的补丁所补偿。这些发现为 Mer2 和 Spp1 的结构组织及其在减数分裂 DSB 机制组装中的作用提供了见解。
